mapper.insert: INSERT INTO conversation_session (user_id, start_time, last_active, current_recipe_id, current_step_index, cooking_mode, status) VALUES (#{userId}, NOW(), NOW(), #{currentRecipeId}, #{currentStepIndex}, #{cookingMode}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM conversation_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'active' ORDER BY last_active DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE conversation_session SET last_active = NOW(), current_recipe_id = #{currentRecipeId}, current_step_index = #{currentStepIndex}, cooking_mode = #{cookingMode}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
